title: List the files open over SMB
description: Show the files that clients hold open on the file server, with the user and the client.

examples.description: Show the files one user holds open
Find who holds a file open in one folder
Count the open files of a remote file server

notes: Run it on the file server, or add -CimSession to query one remotely. Requires administrator rights.
